title: fix(objectql): a refused upgrade leaves the installed version serving

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X9F4WB6WC7HbnKY2zFdJQQe)_

Refs #28697

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the published `SchemaRegistry` gains one public method, `restoringOnRefusal`
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：已安装的包升级时，如果注册表在注册新版本的过程中拒绝了它，已安装的版本继续完整地服务：包记录、对象、应用、条目、选项列表、命名空间、权限集名和默认记录页都回到升级之前的样子。其他包对它的对象的扩展、租户的覆盖层都保持不变。
- **为什么改**：升级被拒后，系统应当和升级前完全一样，运维修好包再装即可。拒绝本身（错误码、状态、文字）不变，变的只是拒绝之后留下了什么。
- **风险与回滚**：objectql patch。注册表在升级写入每个条目之前先记下它原来的样子，被拒时只把这些条目放回去，从不经过卸载。首次安装、干净的升级行为不变。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `restoringOnRefusal` 和各个 `note*` 记录点（`registerObject`、`registerItem`、`installPackage`、`registerPicklistExtension`、命名空间与两类声明）；`engine.ts` 的 `registerApp` 里升级走它的那一处。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts`，预期 13 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **A refused upgrade leaves the installed version serving, whole.** When `ObjectQL.registerApp` re-registers an installed package id and the registry refuses the new version, the package record, every object (as served and as layered), app and item, picklist options and extensions, namespaces, permission-set names, default record pages and datasource definitions read exactly as before the upgrade. Another package's extension of its objects and a tenant's overlay of them are untouched and still served.
- **`SchemaRegistry.restoringOnRefusal(register)`** (new public method) runs one synchronous registration. Before the run's first write to an entry, it records what that entry held: an object's contributor list, a namespace's owners, an item slot (the package record included), the package's extension of one picklist, and the security-catalog and default-record-page claims the package door records. If the run throws, it puts back exactly those entries, re-resolves merged objects and throws the same error. Entries the run did not write are never recorded and never put back. It never goes through uninstall.
- **The engine** runs an upgrade's registration through it. An upgrade means a package record already answers the id. A first install keeps the existing withdrawal, a clean upgrade registers as before, and every refusal keeps its code, status and words.
- The shared registry test double models the new member by running the body as given.

## Why

An upgrade that is refused should leave the running system exactly as it was, so the operator can fix the package and upgrade again while the installed version keeps serving.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts` (new, 13 tests). An installed version with objects, an app, items, a picklist, another package's extension and a tenant overlay; then a newer version the registry refuses, one case for each registry refusal that can arrive during an upgrade. Each case asserts the same code and status, and that everything the engine serves reads exactly as before the upgrade, the extension and the overlay included. Controls: a clean upgrade behaves as before and keeps the extension and the overlay; a refusal raised before anything is written leaves the installed version as before; the other package's entries do not move.
- `package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts`: the control "an installed id refused part-way by the registry is not withdrawn" now asserts the installed version keeps serving.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/install-local-refused-package-leaves-nothing.dogfood.test.ts`: new case 4. Through `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, a refused upgrade answers 422 `PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` as before, and afterwards the installed version, its object (with another package's extension field) and its app read exactly as before the upgrade.

## Acceptance notes

- A tenant overlay is pinned at the unit layer only. Through the HTTP doors, an overlay of a managed package's object cannot be saved (`403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, ADR-0131 D6), so the dogfood case pins the other package's extension instead.
- The restore covers what one registration writes into the registry. The engine's own writes (the package manifest it keeps for routing, datasource definitions, navigation contributions, contributed kinds) were already written only after a whole registration, and still are.

## Verification

All readings below are on the tree of `f72ef4f7`.

<details><summary>Red first on base (`c064d3a2`)</summary>

- Unit, with `engine.ts`, `registry.ts` and the test double taken from `c064d3a2`: the two files ran 11 failed and 26 passed. The 11 are the ten refused-upgrade cases and the flipped control. On the first red run each case passed its code-and-status assertion and failed at the state comparison. The three controls and every case of the earlier file pass. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- Dogfood, with `engine.ts` and `registry.ts` from `c064d3a2`, objectql rebuilt and the dist preflight showing `restoringOnRefusal` absent: 1 failed and 3 passed (case 4). Restored (blob == HEAD, diff empty) and rebuilt; the preflight showed the marker present and the tree clean.
</details>

<details><summary>Green</summary>

- `package-refused-upgrade-keeps-installed.test.ts` 13/13 and `package-refused-registration-withdrawn.test.ts` 24/24.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 520 files, 9996 tests, all green. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck` OK, ledger held).
- Dogfood, with the `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure built under the lock: `install-local-refused-package-leaves-nothing` 4/4 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
</details>

The `--ran` reconciliation reads 68 accounted, 67 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun. `test:repo` and the lint farm run in CI. The full dogfood battery was not run, since the title has no `!` and there is no narrowing arm.

Overlap: open PRs were re-read before opening. #28811 (draft) touches `registry.ts` at the top of `registerObject`, away from these hunks. #28791 merged after this branch was cut, and this branch merges with `main` cleanly (`git merge-tree`).
